title: Rate Schedule for the Interest in a Telephone Payment on an Auto Loan
content:
The rate at which the interest in a telephone payment on a loan of the Auto Loans line is worked out is read from two records together: the borrower's purchases on their Personal Credit Cards account over the last twelve months, and the scheduled installments credited to the loan over the same twelve months.

| Card purchases over the last twelve months | Scheduled installments credited to the loan in the last twelve months | Rate at which the interest is worked out |
|---|---|---|
| At least 9000.00 USD | At least 12 | The floor rate the product publishes |
| At least 3000.00 USD, with either reading short of the row above | At least 6, with either reading short of the row above | The rate recorded on the loan, less the automatic-payment reduction the product publishes |
| Any other reading | Any other reading | The rate recorded on the loan |

The interest is worked out at the product's floor rate where the borrower's card purchases over the last twelve months total at least 9000.00 USD and at least 12 scheduled installments have been credited to the loan in the last twelve months.

It is worked out at the rate recorded on the loan less the automatic-payment reduction the product publishes where those purchases total at least 3000.00 USD and at least 6 scheduled installments have been credited in the last twelve months, while either those purchases fall short of 9000.00 USD or those installments fall short of 12.

It is worked out at the rate recorded on the loan for every other borrower.

## Where the readings come from

The purchase total is the sum of purchases posted to the borrower's card account in the Personal Credit Cards line over the twelve months ending today. The installment count is the number of scheduled payments credited to the auto loan over the same twelve months.

## Readings that fall to the middle row

A borrower with 9000.00 USD of card purchases and 11 installments credited falls to the middle row: 9000.00 is at least 3000.00, 11 is at least 6, and the installments fall short of 12.

A borrower with 8999.99 USD of card purchases and 20 installments credited also falls to the middle row, this time because the purchases fall short.

A borrower with 2999.99 USD of card purchases falls to the bottom row whatever their installment count.
